data.gender_notes: Kanza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kanza is an Arabic name that refers to a treasure or a precious thing. It symbolizes a person who is valuable and cherished. The name Kanza carries the meaning “Treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kanza usually hope their child will grow to embody treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Kanza is considered a treasure from Allah, emphasizing the child's importance in the eyes of God.
data.etymology: Kanza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanza total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
